title: Public read-only GraphQL for live islands on static pages
description: Pages stay static. Add a public, read-only, rate-limited surface on the CMS app's GraphQL API, scoped to published content only (latest items, search, item metadata), so static pages can host small live islands. M8's static JSON (_data/search-index.json, latest.json) and <papyrus-search> are the starting point. No drafts, no editorial data, nothing writable. Document the guest surface and add a test that unpublished items are invisible.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Deferred this run. Estimate 3-4 days: guest-scoped AppSync auth mode or API key with field-level authorization on a published-only read model, WAF rate limit, schema/doc for the guest surface, test that unpublished items are invisible.

right_now_summary: The team is designing a public, rate-limited GraphQL API for published content on static pages.
